prompt: A community hall packed with about forty people on folding chairs, seen from a lens fixed high at the back corner of the room, looking down towards a small raised platform. Brandon stands at the front on the right of the frame with one hand held out, his chin up, his eyebrows lifted and his mouth open mid-sentence, speaking with total ease. Every head in the room is turned towards him, a sea of backs of heads, woolly hats and thinning crowns, a woman near the front leaning in with her elbow on her knee. A tea urn and a trestle table sit unattended at the side, and the strip lighting is flat and slightly green. The colour is washed out and compressed with fine video noise. Thanks.
